summary: Evolution Petroleum Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 3,700,000 common shares at $3.25 per share, with a 30-day over-allotment option for an additional 555,000 shares. The offering is firm commitment, managed by Roth Capital Partners and Northland Capital Markets, expected to close August 20, 2026. Proceeds before expenses are $11.3 million. This is a routine equity capital raising under an existing shelf registration, not a special-situation transaction. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No structural changes, premium, or board recommendation involved. Watch for potential dilution impact on the stock price.
